rules.statement: The Supreme Court of Sri Lanka has the power to exercise its revisional jurisdiction over partition decrees, even when such decrees are stated to be conclusive against all persons.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think that the insertion of the words I have quoted from section 48 (1) made any difference. The phrase is entirely tautologous."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 48(1) of the Partition Act, which provides: 'Every decree for partition or sale under this Act shall be good and conclusive against all persons whomsoever, subject to the decision on any appeal which may be preferred therefrom; and the right, share or interest awarded thereby shall be free from all encumbrances whatsoever other than those specified in that decree.'
